name: FT-891
subtitle: Field reference
kicker: Independent reference. Not a Yaesu publication and not affiliated with Yaesu.
verified: Compiled from Yaesu's published specifications, September 2026. Not checked against a radio, and the operating manual was not read, so the panel is left for you to fill in.
specs: 160 through 10 m including 60 m and the WARC bands, plus 6 m
100 W on SSB, CW and FM; 25 W AM
13.8 V DC, plus or minus 15 percent
notes: Fifteen amps key down is a field power problem, not a radio problem. Size the battery, the fuse and the wire for the current the radio actually draws, then run it at the power the contact needs.
A hundred watts from a portable battery is a short outing. Most of what this radio does well in the field it does at thirty or forty.
It has no internal tuner. Whatever you put up has to be resonant or matched by something you carried in.
The detachable head is a connector, and connectors fail. Carry the spare cable or accept that a bad day ends early.
